query: BGS G-BASE soil stream sediment stream water point data licence
notes: Open derived grids exist, but primary survey point observations require a separate licence and cannot enter open-only production.

notes: Official query service and project spreadsheets identified; licence, field dictionaries, methods and duplication require audit.

notes: Pinned CC BY 4.0 global-ocean release with quality-controlled trace element data; file inventory and adapter validation are next gates.

query: GLORICH global river chemistry database DOI licence
notes: Large global river compilation is DOI-pinned but CC BY-NC-SA, so it is excluded from open-only production and retained for coverage discovery.

query: EEA Waterbase water sediment chemical quality data download
notes: European reporting database exposes downloadable chemical-quality data; dynamic versions, national heterogeneity and dataset-specific notices require audit.

query: NOAA NCEI marine lacustrine rock sediment geochemistry archive IMLGS ERDDAP
notes: Official archive contains heterogeneous rock and sediment geochemistry; IMLGS is a sample inventory and is not represented as a uniform measurement table.

query: PANGAEA georeferenced Earth environmental geochemical dataset DOI API licence
notes: Global DOI repository and search channel; every returned dataset keeps its own media, method, files, licence and upstream identity.

query: IODP ODP DSDP core sediment rock interstitial water chemistry data systems
notes: Official program points to multiple operator and legacy systems; data must be resolved by expedition, site, hole, depth and moratorium status.

query: EMODnet Chemistry marine water sediment contaminants ERDDAP CDI access
notes: European marine aggregator exposes harmonised unrestricted collections and mixed-access CDI records; original data-centre lineage must be retained.

query: JAMSTEC DARWIN rock sediment core samples observation downloads GANSEKI lineage
notes: Current official system verifies cruise, dive, rock and sediment-core sample discovery; no uniform numerical geochemistry endpoint was assumed.

query: Ireland Tellus soil stream sediment stream water geochemistry downloads methods
notes: Official multi-media survey entry identified; the main GSI site was temporarily offline during review, so exact release files and licence notices remain a production gate.

query: Sweden SGU geochemical atlas till CSV methods detection limits
notes: Official raw till endpoint and method/detection-limit tables are available; raw soil observations were not inferred from comparative summary tables.

query: Finland GTK rock till stream sediment geochemistry Hakku ArcGIS
notes: National rock product and separate till or stream-sediment services found; each product and layer requires its own licence, method and version review.

query: Norway NGU LITO national bedrock geochemistry June 2026 spreadsheet methods QC
notes: Official June 2026 preliminary release covers more than 3,600 samples and documented methods; NGU states final naming and batch QC are not complete.

query: Norway MarChem marine sediment geochemistry contaminants download licence DOI
notes: Official downloadable marine-sediment database states CC BY 4.0 and NLOD and points to dataset DOIs; a concrete release still needs pinning.

query: Mexico SGM GeoInfoMex geochemical cartography stream sediment SHP licence
notes: Official national 1:250,000 stream-sediment-derived layer found; federal CC BY 4.0 label conflicts with the more restrictive GeoInfoMex notice, and raw sample measurements are not yet proven.

query: British Columbia RGS regional geochemical survey database download samples determinations methods
notes: The 2020 province-wide release reports 65,000 samples and about five million determinations from 116 original sources, 18 methods and 18 laboratories; selected files and third-party lineage still require audit.

query: Alaska DGGS WebGeochem bulk download methods detection limits publication lineage
notes: Ongoing official database exposes searchable or all-record downloads and retains publication and analytical information; first adapter should prefer a pinned DGGS raw-data publication over an unversioned global export.

query: Chile SERNAGEOMIN geochemical mapping drainage sediment database viewer elements samples
notes: Official program and viewer found; SERNAGEOMIN reports more than 10,000 drainage-sediment samples over more than 230,000 square kilometres and up to 66 elements, but access and licence remain product-specific.

query: Argentina SEGEMAR SIGAM multielement stream sediment soil geochemical open catalogue
notes: Official open geospatial catalogue exposes multielement stream-sediment and soil sample products; annual reporting states more than 40,000 records, while per-layer licence, method and version facts remain unresolved.

query: India GSI NGCM national geochemical mapping repository stream sediment 66 elements
notes: Official program documents describe 2-by-2-kilometre stream-sediment cells and 66 elements, but the public atlas currently returns zero records and the located numerical distribution route is login or event specific.

query: Japan GSJ geochemical map sample concentrations river marine sediment WMS download
notes: Official database reports about 3,000 river- and 5,000 marine-sediment samples and public point/concentration data; WMS and WMTS expose As, Cu, Ni and Zn maps but are treated as derived visual services.

query: South Africa Council for Geoscience geochemistry point layer ArcGIS As Cu Ni Zn
notes: A public official point layer exposes target-element fields and coordinates for a stream-sediment or fallback-soil map sheet; the portal is not assumed to be one continuous national table and CGS product copyright terms remain binding.

query: PANGAEA North Africa deflatable soil elemental composition sample coordinates ICP-MS
notes: Concrete DOI dataset separated from the generic repository entry: 43 sample rows, 48 elemental fields, CC BY 4.0, HF-HNO3 digestion, Agilent 7900 ICP-MS and a pinned 30,336-byte UTF-8 table with SHA-256. Repository and dataset are not counted as independent scientific evidence.

query: GSJ Geochemical Map Japan samplejoho.csv noudo.csv Shift_JIS JGD2000 Hg ppb
notes: Pinned the official 2024 sample table and 2007 concentration table by size and SHA-256. Both contain 3,024 valid rows; sample 78013 occurs twice and is joined by occurrence order. The adapter preserves JGD2000, Hg ppb and other trace-element ppm semantics. Marine sediment and surface-soil products remain separate.

query: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas Europe topsoil CSV XRF ICP-MS aqua regia
notes: Split the parent atlas into a concrete topsoil dataset; pinned the official archive and five selected analysis CSV members by size and SHA-256, with total and aqua-regia measurement bases kept separate.

query: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas Europe subsoil CSV XRF ICP-MS aqua regia
notes: Split the parent atlas into a concrete subsoil dataset; pinned the official archive and five selected analysis CSV members by size and SHA-256, with depth and total versus aqua-regia semantics preserved.

notes: Split the parent atlas into a concrete humus dataset; pinned the official archive and three selected CSV members, and represented mild nitric-acid extraction as extractable rather than total concentration.

query: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas Europe filtered stream water CSV ICP-QMS
notes: Split the parent atlas into a concrete stream-water dataset; pinned the official archive and analysis member and retained filtration, acidification, dissolved operational fraction and ICP-QMS method boundaries.

query: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas Europe stream sediment CSV XRF ICP-MS aqua regia
notes: Split the parent atlas into a concrete stream-sediment dataset; pinned the official archive and four analysis CSV members, retained the less-than-150-micrometre fraction and separated total from aqua-regia results.

query: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas Europe floodplain sediment CSV XRF ICP-MS aqua regia
notes: Split the parent atlas into a concrete floodplain-sediment dataset; pinned the official archive and four analysis CSV members and kept sample depth and total versus aqua-regia measurement bases explicit.

query: AfSIS Phase I wet chemistry 2002 archived soil samples Africa Dataverse version 2.0
notes: Pinned the three original Dataverse files by publisher MD5, local SHA-256 and byte size. The adapter reconciles 2,002 unique samples, 18 country labels, 51 site pairs, depth, coordinates, six target elements, variable methods and source-wide DL/QL. Numeric negative and below-limit results remain explicit quality flags rather than hard deletion.

query: TPDC 10.11888/Terre.tpdc.302620 China mountain soil multi-element official file API
notes: Resolved the DOI to the official TPDC UUID, metadata POST API, open file inventory and file-ID download. Pinned the 1,828,683-byte ZIP and all three member hashes. The main workbook has 1,314 O/A/C-horizon rows and 6,570 Cr/Cu/Ni/Pb/Zn target observations with complete coordinates and parent-rock/soil fields. As and Hg are absent. The separate bulk-density workbook has fillable gaps plus six non-missing value conflicts and five coordinate conflicts, so it cannot silently overwrite the main table. Adapter integration waits for the V4 sample/method/geology schema.

query: USGS-11447650 Sacramento River Freeport dissolved arsenic NWIS WQP 2010 2025
notes: Pinned the exact result and station query responses by URL, byte size and SHA-256. The adapter reconciles 189 dissolved-arsenic observations at one USGS station, including method PLM10, laboratory, detection limits, 132 accepted and 57 preliminary results, 179 routine samples and 10 field replicates. This method-rich time series is an independent freshwater validation route, not national coverage.

query: Geoscience Australia NGSA mercury concentrations DOI 10.26186/150328
notes: Pinned the official DOI release, file identity, publication date and 208,089-byte CSV. The adapter reconciles 2,396 total-Hg determinations across TOS and BOS sediment samples. The reported 0.01 ng Hg mass LOD is not promoted to a concentration detection limit.

query: GSJ Geochemical Map of Sea and Land of Japan marine sediment ocean-noudo.csv
notes: Registered the official concentration-table identity, 1,825,190-byte file, Shift-JIS encoding and 4,905-sample schema. The adapter yields 34,334 target observations and preserves Hg ppb separately from the other ppm elements; missing methods and negative Hg values remain explicit.

query: PANGAEA Arabian Sea modern sediment geochemistry DOI 10.1594/PANGAEA.950139
notes: Pinned the DOI, publication date, source file identity and 24,152-byte tab export. The adapter reconciles 27 rows from 26 events and 162 As/Cr/Cu/Ni/Pb/Zn observations while retaining the publisher's generic bulk-sediment method wording.

query: GEOROC Intraplate Volcanics Antarctica version 12.0 Dataverse member
notes: Pinned dataset DOI, member DOI, Dataverse file ID, version, release date, filename, 367,799-byte file, schema and exact row/analyte counts. One coordinate range remains an area; missing row-level winning methods remain explicit. This is a second concrete rock dataset but shares the GEOROC compilation lineage.

query: USGS whole-rock volcanic geochemistry Utah adjacent states DOI 10.5066/P1NZXUZF
notes: Pinned the release DOI, version, ScienceBase child item and eleven fixed CSV table identities. The adapter reconciles 246 rock rows and 1,447 target observations, preserves 454 less-than results and retains 176 explicit method candidate sets. This supplies an independent non-GEOROC rock lineage; overlap with NGD-Rock remains marked for natural-key duplicate auditing.

query: CDoGS survey 21:0102 lake sediment package data
notes: Pinned two official package workbooks and filtered only authoritative Survey_Key 21:0102. Reconciled 4,411 source-native lake-sediment observations across 684 field sample identifiers and 580 sites, with method and detection-limit evidence.

notes: Pinned the official lake-water package workbook and filtered only Survey_Key 21:0102. Reconciled 655 uranium observations across 580 sites. The water and sediment products share one upstream survey lineage, and conflicting sample-year evidence remains unresolved.
